title: Add glass display cases to the Test-scene lab
description:
## Summary
Add glass display cases to the Test-scene research lab (`Assets/Test.unity`) to house specimen props such as small creature models, tubes, and samples.

## User Mandate
> "Some glass display cases eventually would be cool, but can be tracked as future improvement."

The user explicitly deferred this item to a future task while working on TSK-0257. This task exists so the request is tracked, not lost.

## Scope
In scope: a ProBuilder glass display case prefab (frame, glass panels, shelf, base lighting) plus one or more instances in `Assets/Test.unity`.
Out of scope: TSK-0257 terminal work; any creature DNA or runtime change.

## Acceptance criteria
- A reusable glass display case prefab exists with a metal frame, transparent glass panels, an internal shelf, and interior lighting.
- At least one case is placed and populated with an existing lab specimen prop.
- Transparency uses the verified URP/Lit alpha bundle, not an alpha colour alone.
- No null/magenta material; console has no new errors; scene saved with screenshot evidence.
